name: OpenVibe.Host

site.name: Hosting
site.what: Cloud, VPS and dedicated plans, hosting offers, domain prices and benchmarks people run side by side, each with the day it was checked and its source; never ranked by who pays.
site.description: OpenVibe.Host compares hosting: plans from providers' official APIs and staff entries that name their source, priced per month, per vCPU and per GB, each dated and linked to its source; offers posted on LowEndSpirit's Offers board; domain prices per ending with a name check at the registry; and benchmarks people run with YABS on their own servers. Its console lists your own servers on Linode, DigitalOcean, Vultr and Hetzner Cloud in one place. The order comes only from the visitor's sort; affiliate links are marked. Static hosting is OpenVibe.Space.

pillars.title: Sourced prices
pillars.text: Plans come from providers' official APIs or from staff entries that name the page they were copied from. Nothing is estimated.

pillars.title: Dated
pillars.text: Every price shows the day it was last checked, and each plan keeps its price history.

pillars.title: Compare what matters
pillars.text: Sort by monthly price or by price per vCPU, per GB of RAM or per GB of disk; unknown values stay unknown.

pillars.title: Ranked by you
pillars.text: No paid placement: affiliate links are marked, disclosed beside the link, and never change the order.

pillars.title: Domains too
pillars.text: Every ending's first year, renewal, transfer and five-year cost, a mark where the renewal jumps, and a name check at the registry.

faq.question: Where do the prices come from?
faq.answer: From providers' and registrars' official APIs and public price lists through OpenVibe.Sources, or from staff entries that name the page they came from. Every price shows the day it was checked and links its source.

faq.question: Can I compare domain names?
faq.answer: Yes. Domains shows what registrars charge for each ending for the first year, a renewal and a transfer, and five years added up. A name check asks the registry whether a name is taken.

faq.question: Does anyone pay to be ranked higher?
faq.answer: No. The order comes only from the sort you pick. Affiliate links are marked and disclosed beside the link, and never change the order.

faq.question: Can I host a website here?
What is the console?
faq.answer: One list of your own servers on Linode, DigitalOcean, Vultr and Hetzner Cloud, at openvibe.host/console. Connect each account with its own API token: Host checks it with the provider, seals it and never shows it again. From the list you can power a server on or off or reboot it, and see when the catalog has the same size for less. Disconnecting deletes the token.

faq.question: Where do the benchmarks come from?
faq.answer: From people running YABS on their own servers with a one-time link from openvibe.host/catalog/benchmarks/new. A result keeps the CPU, memory and disk, Geekbench scores with their public link, fio disk speeds, iperf3 network speeds and the city and network. Never the server's address, and never who ran it on the public page.

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP (the Host API on 4910; the ovhost CLI is not a daemon); it checks nothing else (the database and dependencies are what ready checks)

drains: worker stopped (domain checks, object sweep, outbox prune)

resumes.what: pending custom domains are checked again; objects no deploy references and interrupted temp files are swept after an hour
unsent events in the outbox table go to OpenVibe.Events once the relay starts (at least once; Events dedupes by event_id)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart (30 s in host.example.json); manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: the schema code only adds (CREATE … IF NOT EXISTS, ADD COLUMN; no DROP, RENAME or table rebuild), which an older release ignores

claims.what: one ovhost operation at a time per service (deploy and rollback; a drill and backup --all take their own locks)
claims.holder: the ovhost process: <stateDir>/locks/<service>.lock holds its pid
claims.fencing: a lock whose pid is no longer alive is removed and taken again (exclusive create); a live holder refuses the second operation

notes: Stage A: the ovhost operator CLI (no server). The Host service on port 4910 (unit openvibe-host.service) serves openvibe.host, hosting compared: providers, plans and promotions with dated, sourced prices from OpenVibe.Sources and staff entries (host.catalog.manage), discussion on OpenVibe.Community and its pages as OpenVibe.Search documents (host.index_document.*). The ovhost CLI publishes host.release.published. Stage B (tenant static hosting) moved to OpenVibe.Space on 2026-10-12 (plan T20): its host.* capabilities and events are retired at 0.150.0 in favour of space.*, and Host answers the old routes and tenant hosts with 410 host.moved_to_space.
